description: This file defines a React context provider 'UserProvider' managing user state, including profile, cart, authentication, and related actions for a food delivery app.

classes.name: UserProvider
classes.description: React component providing user state and actions via context.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful profile query, identifies user in analytics.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out user, clears storage, resets client cache.

methods.name: addQuantity
methods.description: Increases quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: removeQuantity
methods.description: Decreases quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: checkItemCart
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the cart.

methods.name: numberOfCartItems
methods.description: Calculates total number of items in cart.

methods.name: addCartItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart.

methods.name: setCartRestaurant
methods.description: Sets current restaurant in state and storage.
